sovereign_country.strategic_role: 连接拉美市场的欧洲商贸桥梁、本地化仓配与数字游民签证

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Laser Micro-Machining of Bioresorbable Vascular Polymer Stents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo, as amended by Real Decreto-ley 7/2021; implementing regulation approved by Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, as updated; Real Decreto 609/2023 on the Central Beneficial Ownership Register; together with Ley de Sociedades de Capital (Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010) and the transposition of EU Directives 2015/849 and 2018/843.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, good standing, and directorship of the foreign corporate shareholder (certificado de vigencia de la entidad)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or official corporate registry in the country of incorporation of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority of the shareholder's country of origin; if not a Hague party, Spanish consular legalization; in all cases sworn translation into Spanish

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special power of attorney to incorporate the SL (poder especial para elevar a público la constitución de la sociedad), including representation of UBOs and signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin of each grantor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Spanish consular legalization; sworn Spanish translation required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified photocopy of passport and proof of tax residence or address of each UBO, director, and participating shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National identity or passport authority, or a notary public in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy followed by Hague Apostille or Spanish consular legalization; sworn Spanish translation required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference and source-of-funds statement (referencia bancaria y declaración de origen de fondos) covering the initial capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank holding the UBO or corporate shareholder's account; where unavailable, a chartered accountant or legal counsel affidavit in the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Spanish consular legalization; sworn Spanish translation required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories must be screened before registration against PEP databases under Ley 10/2010, OFAC SDN list, UN Consolidated Sanctions List, EU consolidated asset-freeze list, and SEPBLAC/domestic money-laundering indicators. Enhanced due diligence, including source of wealth and source of funds documentation, senior management approval, and ongoing monitoring, is mandatory for PEPs and for any sanctions or negative media hit. Confirmed adverse hits require refusal of the relationship and, where applicable, a suspicious transaction report to SEPBLAC under Article 18 of Ley 10/2010.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central online denomination service (www.rmc.es) and the CIRCE/SUMA electronic incorporation portal for simplified S.L. formation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A Spanish SL must include the legal form wording 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or the abbreviation 'S.L.' in its denomination. Company names may be composed in Spanish or another language provided they are expressed in a Latin/Roman alphabet or properly transliterated into Spanish for registry indexing. The denomination must be distinct, lawful, not misleading, and must not be identical or phonetically/semantically equivalent to an existing registered denomination.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registro Mercantil Central rejects, denies, or requests modification of the requested denomination, the applicant may, within one month from notification, file a recurso de alzada before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública, or may alternatively resubmit a new denomination request immediately. The negative denomination certificate (certificación negativa de denominación social) must remain valid at the execution of the notarial deed; it is generally not extendable before the RMC, but a fresh application can reserve the name on a first-come, first-served basis.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is acceptable as a registered administrative address for correspondence and notarial notices, but it is not sufficient for the required physical direction of the new SL's medical-device manufacturing operations. For Class III drug-eluting stent manufacturing under EU MDR 2017/745 and AEMPS authorization, an actual registered office, a physical manufacturing or quality-control site in Spain or the EU, and a named EU responsible person are statutory and commercial substance prerequisites. Using only a virtual office would fail bank commercial-substance review, AEMPS inspection expectations, and auditor scrutiny.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: high: approximately 80% likelihood of an unannounced or short-notice on-site inspection by AEMPS or an EU notified body within the first 24 months after EU MDR certification for a Class III implantable device; annual surveillance audits are mandatory and may combine announced and unannounced inspections.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Central negative denomination certificate (certificación negativa de denominación social)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff; prevailing RMC fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial fee for execution of the public deed of incorporation and bylaws (escritura de constitución y estatutos)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary elected by the incorporators in the competent Spanish notarial district
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Arancel Notarial (Spanish notarial tariff decree); based on stated capital, folios, and corporate purpose; market benchmark USD 700–1,000

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Provisional tax identification code (NIF provisional) application for the SL in formation
Inscription of the deed in the Provincial Mercantile Registry (inscripción registral)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered office jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Arancel de los Registradores (registry tariff schedule); based on amount of capital and number of entries

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation AML/UBO due diligence, source-of-funds review, and PEP/sanctions screening report for directors and shareholders
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Designated Spanish AML compliance counsel or external compliance advisor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark using Spanish legal hourly rates for a high-risk MedTech manufacturing structure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille, consular legalization, notarized copies, and sworn Spanish translation bundle for foreign corporate and UBO documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority in country of origin, Spanish consulate if required, and sworn translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory apostille and consular fees plus professional sworn translation market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank account pre-incorporation AML advisory, SWIFT/Letter of Credit channel validation, and corporate bank onboarding preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish bank onboarding officer and external legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for corporate banking AML advisory

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010, of 2 July, approving the consolidated text of the Capital Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), particularly Articles 20-27 (formation, public deed and registration), Article 58 (minimum registered capital), Articles 102-105 (registered office), and Articles 128-131 (commercial registry publication).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central and the competent Registro Mercantil Provincial within the Ministry of Justice.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución) submitted for provisional filing and final inscription in the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: For a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada, the minimum share capital is EUR 3,000 (approximately USD 3,250), which must be fully subscribed and fully paid in cash or in-kind before notarisation. The capital contribution must be deposited in a Spanish bank account in the company's name, and the bank's certificate of deposit must be exhibited to the notary. Cash contributions cannot be deferred or partially paid, and shares cannot be issued below par value.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporators hereby subscribe in full the 3,000 quota shares of the company at EUR 1.00 each, representing the entire share capital of EUR 3,000, which has been fully paid into the company's bank account as evidenced by the bank deposit certificate exhibited. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the company shall be established at [enter address in Spain], and that this address shall be declared to the Mercantile Registry and the competent tax authorities. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name of Sole Administrator] is appointed as Sole Administrator, [Name of Secretary] as Secretary, and [Name of Compliance Officer] as Compliance Officer, each such person accepting office and declaring themselves legally eligible. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Sole Administrator is authorised to execute the public deed of incorporation, obtain the tax identification number, and complete all filings required for registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain negative name certificate for the corporate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online or written application for a Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social, requesting approval of the proposed company name. Provide the legal form suffix 'S.L.' and submit up to three alternative names ranked by preference. The certificate confirms that no identical or confusingly similar name is already registered in Spain.
required_dossiers: Valid identity document or NIE of each incorporator
Power of attorney, if the application is made by a representative
Proposed company names, up to three alternatives
Application form prescribed by the Central Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected due to conflict with an existing registration, promptly submit the next preferred alternative; if the name is suspended by a pending objection, request a refined search or await the registry's definitive decision before re-filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open provisional bank account and deposit share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution chosen by the incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the name of the future company, deposit the minimum share capital of EUR 3,000, and obtain a bank certificate confirming the deposit and the identity of the account holder. The certificate must state that the funds are unavailable until the company is registered and the administrators are appointed.
required_dossiers: NIE or passport of each subscriber
Identification of the legal representative submitting the application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank certificate is rejected or lacks the required wording, request a corrected certificate from the bank; if the account is refused because the company is not yet incorporated, use a notary-supervised escrow deposit arrangement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the public deed of incorporation before a notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the negative name certificate, the bank deposit certificate, the draft articles of association (Estatutos Sociales), and the shareholders' personal data to the notary. The notary will verify legal capacity, capital deposit, and statutory content, then execute the Escritura Pública de Constitución. The deed must include the company name, object, registered office address, share capital, shareholding structure, administration body, and statutory rules.
required_dossiers: Passport or NIE of each founding shareholder
Declaration of beneficial ownership and identification forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises a defect or missing declaration, execute a supplementary notarial act (acta de subsanación) or amend the draft before signing; if a shareholder cannot attend, arrange a notarised power of attorney prior to the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the provisional tax identification number (NIF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After execution of the public deed, file Form 036 with the AEAT, together with the first copy of the notarial deed, to obtain a provisional corporate tax identification number (NIF provisional). This number is required for subsequent registry and tax filings.
required_dossiers: First notarial copy of the public deed of incorporation
Proof of the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT queries the filing due to missing signatures or the absence of the deed, provide the certified notarial first copy or correct the representative designation; if the request is suspended, resubmit the dossier through the electronic submission portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the company in the Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial where the registered office is located
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the first notarial copy of the deed of incorporation, together with the provisional NIF certificate and the registration fee, to the Provincial Mercantile Registry within fifteen business days after execution. The registry will examine the deed for legal validity, constitutional compliance, and filing requirements, then record the company inscription.
required_dossiers: First notarial copy of the public deed
Proof of payment of the registry fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a provisional disqualification or suspension (suspension), cure the noted defect by filing a corrective notarial act or supplementary document, then re-present the dossier for a new qualification decision; if the fee is challenged, provide the official fee receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register with the Social Security as an employer
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registry inscription, apply to the TGSS to register the company as an employer and obtain a contribution account code (código de cuenta de cotización). The application identifies the business as an industrial medical-device manufacturer and appoints the company's paying agent for employee social security contributions.
required_dossiers: NIF card or definitive NIF certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If provisional NIF is still outstanding, attach the provisional NIF certificate and a copy of the registry application; if the TGSS rejects the address, verify the municipal zoning certificate and resubmit with a valid industrial address.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios (AEMPS) under the Ministry of Health, together with the municipal authority for industrial activity licence purposes.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturer establishment operating authorisation for sanitary products (Autorización de funcionamiento de instalaciones de fabricación de productos sanitarios) and CE-marking conformity assessment for Class III medical devices under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITERD), acting through the Dirección General de Calidad y Evaluación Ambiental, and the corresponding regional environmental authority.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Simplified environmental impact assessment (EIA simplificada) is likely required for a medical-device manufacturing facility involving cleanrooms, chemicals, and controlled waste streams where production capacity or solvent consumption exceeds applicable thresholds; smaller auxiliary facilities are subject to a municipal environmental intervention procedure (régimen de intervención ambiental) and an environmental statement rather than a full EIA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with the river-basin discharge permit, the consolidated Water Law, and regional quality objectives, including maximum limits for chemical oxygen demand, biochemical oxygen demand, suspended solids, heavy metals, and trace organic compounds; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions from laser machining and cleaning processes must comply with Royal Decree 117/2003 on VOC emission control; hazardous waste, including solvent residues, biomedical waste, and contaminated packaging, must be managed by an authorised waste operator under Law 7/2022.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the competent local fire service, including verification of fire compartmentation, emergency exits, and extinguishing systems; structural load inspection certificate for the production floor, cleanroom, and storage areas prepared by a qualified technical architect; occupational risk prevention clearance under Law 31/1995, comprising a workplace risk assessment, safety signage, ventilation verification, emergency-preparedness plans, and medical/ergonomic surveillance of personnel engaged in stent micro-manufacturing.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); official portal at www.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL) is a resident company that obtains its Tax Identification Number (NIF) as part of the incorporation process before the Mercantile Registry and AEAT. The provisional NIF is issued upon filing of the incorporation deed; the definitive NIF is granted after registry registration. Foreign non-resident legal entities (including the parent/holding company) that are not establishing a branch must obtain a non-resident NIF (model 036/037) from AEAT to engage in taxable activities or to exercise rights and obligations under Spanish tax law. For VAT purposes, the same NIF is used and incorporates the IVA identifier for intra-community and export transactions. Foreign shareholders must appoint a representative with tax residence in Spain and verify non-resident status with corresponding documentation, including the certificate of tax residence of the jurisdiction.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The SL is subject to the general corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) without check-the-box pass-through election. Statutory elections available include: (1) optional incorporation into a consolidated tax group under the special consolidation regime if the parent holds at least 75% of the subsidiary's capital (Article 61 and following of Ley 27/2014); (2) reduced corporate tax rate of 15% for newly created entities carrying out an economic activity for the first two years under certain conditions; and (3) for joint ventures and economic interest groupings, transparent tax treatment under the attribution regime. Hybrid mismatch rules under the Spanish transposition of ATAD (EU) 2017/952 limit deductibility and require recharacterisation, but no elective check-the-box regime is available for the SL itself.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (IVA) – Value Added Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No registration threshold applies to a substantially taxable person; any SL, branch, or permanent establishment performing taxable supplies in the Spanish VAT territory must register for IVA. The simplified and small-business IVA regimes (régimen simplificado, recargo de equivalencia) are only available to natural persons or retail traders, but their application is not a VAT registration threshold in the conventional sense. A specific threshold of €10,000 applies to intra-community distance sales of goods for non-established businesses (artículo 13.2º, regla de localización), below which VAT may be due in the country of arrival rather than in Spain.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Spain mandates B2B electronic invoicing in the supplier-customer relationship under the 'Crea y Crece' Law (Ley 18/2022). The large-business VAT return filing and declaration regime known as Suministro Inmediato de Información (SII / Immediate Supply of Information) applies to merchants and corporations with turnover exceeding €6 million, requiring real-time transmission of all invoice details to AEAT via an API under the XML SII schema. For all businesses, the Veri*Factu system (set to become effective in phases) will require issuance through certified software and the generation of a 'factura verificable' (verifiable invoice) carrying a QR code and an electronic registration record; this will enforce tamper-evidence and real-time clearance of invoices with AEAT. Failure to comply leads to rejection of invoice records and administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods destined for third countries (non-EU territories) are subject to a 0% IVA rate (exempt with credit) where the goods are dispatched or transported from Spain and, within three months from the supply (or longer under justified transport conditions), leave the EU customs territory. The exporter must prove the physical exit by means of the customs export declaration (DUA/SAD) containing the registration number and the exit acceptance date. Ancillary and transport services directly linked to the export are also zero-rated if performed for the exported goods and evidenced in the same documentation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Commercial invoice and full export contract
Packing list and transport documents demonstrating departure from Spain
Proof of receipt of goods at destination when available (barcode, CMR, AWB, or POA)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Spanish VAT law requires strict substantiation and retention of export evidence for a minimum period of four years. AEAT may retrospectively claw back IVA claimed as zero-rated if the documentation is incomplete, inconsistent, or the goods are found to have re-entered the EU without lawful declaration. The clawback is assessed with late-payment interest, plus a penalty regime under the General Tax Law (Ley 58/2003) ranging from 50% to 150% of the lost VAT when there is negligence or concealment. In cases of willful fraud, criminal liability under Article 305 of the Penal Code (delito contra la Hacienda Pública) may be imposed, with penalties of two to six years of imprisonment and fines equal to six times the defrauded amount. AEAT has access to customs manifests, banking records, and inward remittance data to detect overclaimed or invented export shipments.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates under a fully convertible Euro regime. Capital account transactions are permitted subject to Bank of Spain notification for transactions exceeding €50,000. Current account transactions, including profit remittances, face no convertibility restrictions but require supporting documentation for tax and AML compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export receipts denominated in foreign currency must be surrendered to a Spanish resident bank within six months of collection. Conversion to EUR occurs at the official exchange rate published by the Bank of Spain. Required documentation includes commercial invoices, packing lists, and proof of shipment.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Cross-border Electronic Money Institutions licensed by the Banco de España are feasible for treasury operations but constrained by capital adequacy and AML obligations. For Class III MedTech manufacturing, integration with traditional banking rails is recommended to mitigate liquidity and compliance risks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors and authorized representatives is mandatory for KYC interviews and account opening at tier-one commercial banks. Remote digital onboarding is not permitted for high-risk AML entities in the MedTech sector.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity in MedTech supply chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ultimate beneficial owner declarations, corporate structure charts, and source of wealth affidavits

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export control screening for dual-use technologies in stent manufacturing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: End-user certificates, export licenses, and technical specifications confirming non-military application

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections routed via SWIFT MT103 in EUR with purpose code 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION'. Verification protocols include board resolutions, shareholder agreements, and tax identification verification. All inbound wires subject to Spanish Central Bank reporting thresholds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements processed through SWIFT MT103 or MT700/MT710 for Commercial Letters of Credit. Payments require underlying trade documents including invoices, transport waybills, and compliance with EU export regulations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency swaps for multi-currency exposure management

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Accounts (Cuentas Anuales) with audit report if required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil (Commercial Registry) of the corporate domicile province
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within 6 months after fiscal year-end; deposit within 30 days after approval. For calendar year: approved by June 30, filed by July 30.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EUR 3,000; company's registry sheet is closed, blocking all subsequent registrations; director disqualification; possible compulsory strike-off after persistent non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months and 25 days after fiscal year-end; for calendar year: by July 25.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% to 20% of the tax amount plus late-payment interest; minimum penalty EUR 200; potential director personal liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between January 1 and March 1 for the preceding calendar year, if aggregate annual operations with any counterparty exceed EUR 3,005.06.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty from EUR 200 to EUR 20,000 based on omitted amounts; additional surcharge of 1.5% on net underreported volume.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Summary of Withholdings (Modelo 190), if employees or professionals are compensated
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between January 1 and March 1 for the preceding calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of EUR 150 per item with a minimum of EUR 300; possible additional 2% charge on undeclared amounts.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if at least two of the following three criteria are met for two consecutive years: total assets exceed EUR 2,850,000; annual net turnover exceeds EUR 5,700,000; average number of employees exceeds 50.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General de Contabilidad) for individual annual accounts; IFRS as adopted by the EU for consolidated accounts of listed groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Spain requires registration of ultimate beneficial owners in the Registro de Titularidades Reales at incorporation and any subsequent change must be filed within one month. There is no standalone annual UBO confirmation; however, the Commercial Registry will review shareholding transfers during the annual accounts deposit process and may require updated UBO filing if discrepancies or transfers are detected.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro Registro de Administradores)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – USD 12,000 (EUR 3,600 – EUR 10,800) depending on size and complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Newly created SLs benefit from a reduced 15% rate for the first tax period with a positive tax base and the immediately following period (Art. 29.1 Ley 27/2014, LIS). R&D and Technological Innovation tax credits: 25% on qualifying R&D expenditure and 8% on technological innovation activities, with an additional 17% on the incremental R&D spend; assessable R&D credits limited to 25% of the gross tax liability (50% where qualifying R&D exceeds 10% of turnover). Patent box regime: 60% exemption of qualifying income from assigns or transfers of certain intangibles under Art. 23 LIS. Capitalisation reserve: 10% deduction of retained earnings allocations up to 10% of the tax base.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 200 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) submitted exclusively through the Sede Electrónica de la Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); mandatory electronic filing for all corporate entities using XML/PDF generation via the AEAT online platform.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 days following the six-month period after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SL the deadline is 25 July of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Resultado contable antes de impuestos (accounting profit or loss before tax per financial statements).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The wholly or partially foreign-owned Spanish SL is a Spanish resident taxpayer; input the P&L result of the Spanish legal entity without eliminating any internal or foreign branch income; non-resident shareholders have no direct reporting role.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Base imponible (taxable base after statutory adjustments such as non-deductible expenses, impairment reversals ex Art. 13 LIS, or participation exemption adjustments).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include worldwide income of the Spanish resident entity; deduct offsettable prior-year negative tax bases within the 10-year window and apply the capitalisation reserve reduction; additions must reflect non-deductible payments to related parties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cuota íntegra (gross tax liability before credit adjustments, applying 25% or the reduced 15% new-entity rate).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify eligibility for the 15% new-company relief; apply double taxation relief of Art. 31 LIS for prior foreign taxes on dividends or taxable permanent establishment income of the Spanish SL.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Retenciones, ingresos a cuenta y pagos fraccionados (Spanish withholdings, on-account payments, quarterly instalments paid via Modelo 202, and other advance credits).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Creditable only against the Spanish corporate liability; foreign tax credits on royalties or interest of the MedTech company are entered under the separate double-taxation section, supplemented by the applicable DTA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deuda tributaria (final net tax due or refundable after credits and withholdings).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Make payment via direct debit or bank transfer upon filing; if a refund arises, the instruction to return must be explicitly indicated; the DTA-protected non-resident shareholder is not a party to this box.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing without prior AEAT notice triggers a graduated surcharge of 5%-20% (depending on delay) plus late-payment interest (current annual interest around 3.75%). When filed after an official request, the penalty is 50%-150% of the tax amount; purely formal omissions carry fixed sanctions of EUR 200 per data item or group of data items, with minimum fines of up to EUR 10,000 for repeat or serious failures.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 202 (Pago fraccionado del Impuesto sobre Sociedades) via AEAT electronic filing; quarterly prepayment form.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Three instalments per fiscal year (periods ending in April, October and December).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Instalment payments must be filed between 1 and 20 April (first quarter), 1 and 20 October (third quarter, using 9-month results), and 1 and 20 December (11-month results).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Base para calcular el pago fraccionado (the taxable base for the instalment).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an SL with net turnover of EUR 10m or more, the base is the accounting profit of the elapsed months (3/9/11) adjusted for prior losses, capitalisation reserve and tax credits. For smaller taxpayers, the instalment is 20% of the previous year's taxable profits? no technical misstatement avoided: the base under Art. 40.3 LIS.

Large taxpayers (turnover >= EUR 10m) apply 18%; small taxpayers use the 25% rate on the previous year's integrated quota. Foreign parent entities must instruct the Spanish SL to apply the correct percentage to avoid underpayment penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Resultado del pago fraccionado (amount payable per instalment).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Amount is payable by the SL using its Spanish tax identification number; the non-resident shareholder cannot offset its own DTA withholding against this instalment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-presentation or incorrect calculation triggers an instalment surcharge of 5%-20% of the missing amount plus late-payment interest; if the AEAT initiates a formal procedure, a penalty of 50%-150% of the unpaid instalment may apply. Fixed EUR 200 per omitted datum penalties are also possible.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% dividend withholding tax (WHT) on distributions to non-resident shareholders under the Non-Resident Income Tax (IRNR). 0% applies to qualifying EU corporate shareholders holding at least 5% of the SL's social capital for at least one year under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive as transposed in Spanish law. WHT must be declared by the paying SL through Modelo 216 and paid via Modelo 216 within the general filing period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Protocol: (1) The foreign shareholder obtains an official Certificate of Tax Residency (Certificado de Residencia Fiscal) from the local tax authority of its own state. (2) The certificate is transmitted to the Spanish SL (or AEAT) before the distribution date; the SL then applies the reduced DTA rate or Directive exemption at source, retaining the supporting certificate in its records for 10 years. For EU Parent-Subsidiary relief, the SL must hold evidence of the 5% participation and the one-year holding period. (3) Where WHT is applied at 19% in error, the non-resident may claim a refund by filing Modelo 210 or a Spanish telematic refund request within four years from the maturity date of the dividend, accompanying the same TRC documentation. Treaty PPT (Principal Purpose Test) and limitation of benefits clauses are reviewed by the Spanish tax authorities where the SL has no Spanish operational substance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest paid by the Spanish SL to non-residents: statutory WHT 19%; 0% under the EU Interest & Royalties Directive when the beneficial owner is an EU/EEA associated company holding at least 25% indirectly or directly for an uninterrupted two-year period. Patent and trademark royalties (relevant for coronary stent IP): statutory WHT 24%; 0% under the same EU Directive when the associated-entity and holding-period conditions are met; DTA rates generally 0%-10% depending on the treaty, with the TRC protocol applicable. Payments to listed tax-haven territories are denied deductibility in the Spanish corporate tax base and taxed at a special rate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR. Full Spanish TP documentation (Local File and Master File) is mandatory for taxpayers (or groups) whose annual net turnover equals or exceeds EUR 45 million. Regardless of turnover, every Spanish SL engaging in related-party cross-border transactions must file the annual Modelo 232 information return when the aggregate value of such transactions exceeds EUR 250,000 per tax period, or EUR 100,000 for certain transactions (e.g., those with the same related person or passive royalties), and must maintain sufficient comparability analyses and contemporaneous documentation to justify the arm's-length outcome.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spanish domestic law does not impose offshore-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR), but an equivalent substance requirement operates through the Spanish GAAR (Art. 15 LGT conflicto en la aplicación de la norma tributaria), the simulation recharacterisation rule (Art. 13 LGT), CFC rules (Arts. 100-108 LIS), ATAD anti-hybrid provisions, and the OECD Principal Purpose Test in treaty application. For this Class III MedTech manufacturer to retain the reduced rates, patent box benefits, and treaty protection, the SL must have real Spanish business premises, locally employed operational staff, strategic decision-making functions performed in Spain, and economic ownership of the drug-eluting stent IP (R&D, patents and licences allocated to Spain); an artificial 'letterbox' SL distributing stent royalties without Spanish substance will be disregarded and reassessed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Criminal Tax Evasion (Delito contra la Hacienda Pública)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally omitting the Modelo 200, maintaining false accounting records, or concealing foreign royalty and distribution income, in each case defrauding the Spanish Treasury of more than EUR 120,000 in a single tax assessment; the same threshold applies to sham transactions and undisclosed related-party payments channelled through the SL.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Art. 305 Código Penal: imprisonment of 2 to 6 years for natural persons and a fine of at least double the defrauded amount; additional confiscation of assets; loss of eligibility for public subsidies and tax benefits for up to 10 years. For legal entities (Art. 310 bis CP): fine of 2-5 times the defrauded amount, plus potential dissolution, suspension of the SL's activities for up to 5 years, and EU-funding exclusion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under Art. 310 bis CP and Art. 42 LGT, the SL's managing directors, de facto managers and shareholders acting as facilitators who ordered or tacitly approved the evasion are personally, jointly and severally liable; they face criminal imprisonment, civil restitution of the treasury damage, precautionary travel bans (prohibición de salida de España), attachment of personal bank accounts and assets, and in serious cases preventive arrest.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Administrative Tax Infractions and Transfer-Pricing Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Late or inaccurate filing of Modelo 200 or Modelo 202; undervaluation of intercompany royalty income or overvaluation of stent component purchases; failure to maintain or submit TP Local File / Modelo 232; unjustified reliance on the 15% new-entity rate; paying royalties to a related party in a tax-haven or without sufficient Spanish substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Arts. 191-198 LGT: quantitative infractions attract penalties of 50%-150% of the tax differential; violation of TP documentation obligations triggers substantial fines for each missing datum (generally EUR 1,000-EUR 15,000 per infraction) plus a 15% surcharge on the tax adjustment; late surcharges of 5%-20% plus daily interest continue to accrue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The AEAT may apply 'derivación de responsabilidad' under Arts. 42 and 43 LGT: directors and legal representatives are personally and severally liable for corporate tax debts when they actively participated in the creation or non-compliance of the tax obligation, consented to the infraction, or failed to apply due diligence in overseeing the filing and payment; such director liability is recovered by embargo of personal assets and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Artificial Arrangement (Simulación y Abuso Fiscal)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing a Spanish SL without real staff, physical premises or substantive business purpose solely to hold the coronary stent patents, re-invoice intragroup IP royalties, avoid Spanish permanent-establishment status, or otherwise shift profits abroad; interposing shell entities in tax-haven jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Art. 13 LGT: simulated transactions are void and reassessed at their economic substance; Art. 15 LGT (GAAR) permits the AEAT to reverse artificial transactions and recognise the SL's taxable reality; non-recognition of the purported royalty arrangement with full re-inclusion of income, plus penalties of 50%-150% of the corrected tax and late interest; treaty benefits are denied under the Principal Purpose Test in domestic and OECD conventions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Promoting, organising or executing the artificial structure exposes the directors and professional advisers to joint and several liability under Art. 42.2 LGT; where the tax loss exceeds EUR 120,000, the same acts constitute a criminal tax offence under Art. 305 CP with imprisonment; a court may order bankruptcy disqualification of the directors and block them from managing other Spanish companies, while shares in the SL may be seized in enforcement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving or processing Letter of Credit and SWIFT transactions from foreign distribution counterparties without obtaining the ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) declarations, failing to update the Spanish Register of Real Beneficial Owners within 30 days of any shareholding change, or ignoring enhanced due diligence/Sanctions screening (OFAC, UN, EU) in the high-risk Class III MedTech export channel.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Ley 10/2010 sanctions: infractions classified as 'grave' carry fines from EUR 60,000 to EUR 150,000; 'muy graves' penalties range from EUR 150,000 to EUR 5,000,000 or 5-10 times the underlying economic benefit; false UBO registration is independently punishable under Articles 198-199 LGT and company law; the SL may additionally be barred from certain public tenders and lose banking licences.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The AML statute imposes direct liability on the SL's manager or compliance officer who tolerated the non-compliance; a criminal money-laundering conviction under Art. 301 CP carries imprisonment of 1-6 years and a fine of up to 6 times the laundered value; precautionary measures include freezing of funds, travel bans and passport surrender, and civil liability for damages caused to public creditors or commercial counterparties.
